recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. Future formal publications can continue adding or hosting a manually prepared fhir-spec.zip during publication, but the current build source should not advertise an automatically generated CI ZIP unless that generation is deliberately restored.
issue_request: FHIR-17012 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core issue reporting that the index page in the downloadable package did not match the online index; the accepted resolution was to stop automatically producing that downloadable build output, build it manually for publication, and provide no download from build.fhir.org.
initial_application: SVN revision 14430, imported as git commit e426fc3d2ef25df3cbfee90247aea5fee984f8fd, removed Publisher.produceZip and changed source/downloads.html so fhir-spec.zip was plain text marked as not downloadable from build.fhir.org. The producer removal remains in current source.
additional_context: Commit d382fc3af52ab7607c6c8fead1f47cdf09be3562 later reintroduced an active fhir-spec.zip link on source/downloads.html without restoring ZIP generation. The current build.fhir.org downloads page exposed that link while build.fhir.org/fhir-spec.zip returned 404; published release sites can still host manually prepared ZIPs, as R5 does.
reconciliation: Changed source/downloads.html to restore the non-linked 'not downloadable from build.fhir.org' wording for fhir-spec.zip. This keeps the manual publication model intact while removing the broken CI downloads-page link.
source_changes: source/downloads.html: Restored the commented-out fhir-spec.zip link and the not-downloadable-from-build.fhir.org note for the FHIR Specification row.

related_jiras.note: A later published issue about contents of the R4 fhir-spec.zip; it confirms formal release ZIPs are separate publication artifacts and was not part of this CI link fix.
